rules.title: Floating base image tag
rules.description: FROM image:latest (or untagged) — builds are not reproducible. Pin a version or digest.

rules.title: Container runs as root
rules.description: No USER directive — the process runs as root inside the container. Add a non-root user.

rules.title: Secret baked into image layer
rules.description: COPY of .env/credential files, or secrets passed via ARG/ENV — they persist in image history. Use build secrets or runtime mounts.

rules.title: Layer and cache bloat
rules.description: Many separate RUN commands, missing --no-cache-dir / apt cleanup, or COPY . . before dependency manifests — larger images, worse cache hits.

rules.title: ADD where COPY suffices
rules.description: ADD used for local files — it silently unpacks archives and fetches URLs. Prefer COPY unless the extra behavior is intended.
